description: The signed index print Pulse RECORDED nearest a past moment — the tool for settling a contract, pricing an option at expiry, or reconstructing what an asset was worth at a specific timestamp. Returns the observation with its original signature intact — verify it offline with pulse_verify_print, no network call — plus delta_ms, the distance between the time you asked for and the print actually returned; it is the nearest recorded print, never a price synthesised at your exact instant. Accepts ISO-8601 or epoch milliseconds. Requires a Pulse API key via _apiKey. Example: pulse_settlement_print({ symbol: "BTC", at: "2026-09-16T21:41:46.000Z" }).

_apiKey.description: Pulse Verity API key. Free and self-serve at https://thepulse.markets/developers (60 req/min, 25,000/month, no card).

at.description: The moment to price, as ISO-8601 (2026-09-16T21:41:46.000Z) or epoch milliseconds.

name: pulse_settlement_print

delta_ms.description: Distance in ms between requested_at and the print returned

delta_note.description: Explains delta_ms — the returned print is the NEAREST observation to requested_at, not necessarily AT it.

print.description: The signed print Pulse recorded nearest the requested time

at.description: Recorded timestamp, 4th field of the signed canonical string

deltaMs.description: Milliseconds between the requested time and this print

grade.description: consensus/blended/indicative, 5th field of the signed canonical string

grade_note.description: Plain-English meaning of grade and whether it is settleable

kid.description: Key id selecting which public key verifies the signature

price.description: Price as a float; priceText is what was actually signed

priceText.description: Price exactly as served, 3rd field of the signed canonical string

sig.description: Signing scheme tag, 1st field of the canonical string (pulse-index-v1)

signature.description: Base64 ECDSA P-256 signature over the canonical string

symbol.description: Asset ticker, 2nd field of the signed canonical string

requested_at.description: The `at` argument as supplied by the caller

title: Pulse Settlement Print
